userDecision: Keep existing completed art unchanged; adjust subsequent characters only. Ordinary attacks remain weapon-driven.
idleRequirements: Authored blink with pupils fully enclosed; fully closed frame for 0.1 second.

skillRationale.bellpepper: Deploy drone; cast gesture only, drone and lasers remain skill effects.
skillRationale.wintermelon: Activate golden bell; cast gesture only, bell and repulsion remain skill effects.
skillRationale.bittermelon: Cast activates fixed ice field; field damage/status/effects remain in gameplay.
skillRationale.sprout: Cast hand/leaf gesture; existing persistent 1.3x growth buff and its restoration remain gameplay feedback, never counted as drawn frames.

runtimePolicy: Do not package unused optional sheets. Preserve generated originals externally. Add extra skill actions only if gameplay actually invokes them. Existing completed actors remain unchanged.
